ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AB=c$, $AC=b$, $BC=a$, what is the value of $\tan A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since in the right triangle $ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AC=b$, $BC=a$, \\
therefore $\tan A = \frac{a}{b}$, thus $\tan A = \boxed{\frac{a}{b}}$
